profile.headline: Software Engineer at Amazon
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer primarily focused on full stack development. Have produced front to back distributed applications. Skilled in Javascript/Typescript, React and NodeJS and SQL/NoSQL databases. Have used cloud platforms such as AWS (EC2, KMS, DocumentDB, S3) to host distributed systems.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Project: Supporting Meta-Cognitive Strategies for Programming Completion Puzzles

• Led a UI/UX research project to build an interface for “Looking Glass” – a program used to teach
programming concepts to beginners.
• Using Java, JavaFX and Swing, designed and built an interface to guide students through progressively
harder programming concepts.
• Interface tested and used at local high school Hawthorne Leadership School for Girls

positions.title: Quality Assurance Tester - Team Manager
positions.description:
• Prepare and document scripts testing software used by the faculty at the university’s medical campus in research and in medical practice. Train new hires and appoint their workload.
• Promoted to team manager after one summer.
• Created an online checkout system using the LAMP stack to request and track equipment loaned.

positions.title: Student Technology Services Level 1 Tech
positions.description: Troubleshoot and assist with the operation of computer labs; providing first contact support at a Service Desk and for the student population at Washington University.

positions.title: Student Technician
positions.description: Maintain, troubleshoot and assist with the operation of Library Technology Services for Washington University Libraries.

positions.title: Web Development Project Team Leader
positions.description: Manage a team in performing Search Engine Optimization for an online jewelry and apparel store. Collaborate with the team to raise website ranking through web analytics and marketing measurements.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Project: Tire Wrapping Optimization using a 3D Computational Simulation

• Over an 8-week period, the wrapping process of Goodyear tires was implemented as a simulation using MATLAB. Through this simulation, different parameters of the process were tested and their wrapping efficiency evaluated prior to manufacturing.
• Gained experience in computationally implementing complex mathematical and geometrical models and implementing a 3D graphical simulation.
• Delivered this simulation along with a technical report and a user’s manual to Goodyear for their manufacturing purposes.

positions.title: Student Technology Assistant
positions.description: The goal of the Student Technology Assistant Program (STA program) is to provide exceptional educational and professional development opportunities for our students while improving the level and quality of information technology support services to our campus community.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Over the course of an 8 week period during the summer of 2013, a newly synthesized liquid crystal compound was analyzed under different voltage magnitudes, and its behavior mapped.
• Created a computational model in Objective-C to simulate the crystal’s behavior using data gathered
experimentally.
• Developed experience with electrical laboratory equipment, LabView, IgorPro, LaTeX, and Adobe Illustrator. A software model of the liquid crystal system, was built upon on using Objective C.

positions.title: ACM International Collegiate Programming Contest
positions.description: Participated in programming competition involving solutions of mathematical problems through code.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Project: A Frequency- and Clustering-based Methodology for Finding Transcription Factor Binding Sites

• Implemented a frequency- and clustering-based algorithm for finding transcription factor binding sites in the Solanum Lycopersicum tomato genome was created, implemented through software (C++) and scripts (Python, MATLAB).
• Gained experience developing complex searching and sorting algorithms applied to biological data.
• Presented academic paper at the Midstates Conference for Undergraduate Research in Computer Science and Mathematics.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Buckeye Women in Science Engineering and Research Institute (B-WISER)
volunteerExperiences.description: Program promoting the sciences amongst middle school students. Created Sound and Waves model to encourage interest in physics.
